meta.title: Remediation plan: 100% 3dm CLI parity in 3dmakeGUI with direct CLI execution
meta.target: mrhunsaker/3dmakeGUI (assumed TypeScript VS Code extension in vscode-extension/; adapt paths if other front-ends exist)
meta.non_negotiable_requirement: Every GUI control executes the real `3dm` binary with a real argv. The GUI never reimplements 3dm behaviour (no direct file opens in place of edit-*, no JS re-implementation of slicing/orient/preview, no output scraping where a deterministic path exists).
meta.definition_of_done: Every entry in 3dmake_functions.json (actions, global_options, config_keys, input-file mode, interactive prompts) has a reachable GUI control, an automated test asserting the exact argv, and appears in the generated coverage report with zero gaps.

design_principles: Single source of truth: 3dmake_functions.json (checked into the repo as spec/3dm_spec.json) drives argv construction, command-palette registration, menus, and tests. Adding a flag means editing JSON, not code.
No shell: spawn(binary, argvArray, {shell:false}). Never string-concatenate commands. Quote-safe on Windows paths.
Show-what-runs: before and after every run, display the exact command line (copyable) in the Output channel, and expose a 'Copy as CLI command' action. This makes the GUI verifiably non-approximate.
Chains are built as positional verbs in any order (3dm sorts them); the GUI offers a verb multi-select instead of hardcoded pipelines.

Interactive actions run in a real terminal (VS Code Pseudoterminal/Terminal API with node-pty or vscode.window.createTerminal + sendText-free ExecutionTask) so stdin prompts work; non-interactive actions stream to the Output channel for screen-reader aria-live.
Accessibility is preserved: every new control carries accessibilityInformation; completion toasts and aria-live regions remain.

work_items.title: Ground truth sync (regenerate spec from the real CLI)
steps: Add scripts/sync_spec.ts that runs `3dm help` and parses the action list/docstrings, and runs `3dm <verb> --help`-equivalents where available; diff against spec/3dm_spec.json and fail CI on drift.

Read tdeck/3dmake actions/__init__.py once (git clone, not web) to fill every 'verify'/'likely'/'inferred' field in spec: isolated, last_in_chain, implied_actions, input_file_types, internal vs user verbs, ALL_ACTIONS_IN_ORDER.
Scan all of 3dmakeGUI (not just vscode-extension/) and append any other front-ends or commands to 3dmake_gui_functions.json.
acceptance: CI job `spec-drift` passes against pinned 3dm version and against latest release

work_items.title: Core: CLI runner and argv builder (the only place 3dm is invoked)

ThreeDmRequest.actions: string[] (verbs, validated against spec; order irrelevant)
ThreeDmRequest.globalOptions: typed map keyed by spec.global_options[].id; repeatable options are arrays
ThreeDmRequest.inputFile: optional absolute path; enforces: <=1, extension in union of accepted types of chosen actions, mutually exclusive with `model`

design.buildArgv(req): Emits [ ...flagPairs, ...actions, inputFile? ]. Flags use their canonical long form from spec. Repeatables expand as `-o a -o b`. Validates: scale XOR per-axis, view enum or plane pattern, image-size WxH, copies>=1, colorscheme enum, angle enum, percent syntax. Dashed tokens must come from spec only (guards against D1-type bugs).
design.validateChain(req): Rejects isolated actions combined with others (setup, help, version, self-update, plus whatever WI-00 finds), and actions after last_in_chain per internal order, mirroring 3dm.py messages.
design.runner: spawn with shell:false, cwd, env; streams stdout/stderr; returns {argv, exitCode, durationMs, outputs[]}; exit code 2 = user cancelled; supports cancel (SIGINT, then SIGTERM after 3s); captures --debug traces.
design.binary resolution: keep 3dmake.binaryPath / THREE_DM_PATH / THREEDM_PATH / PATH; additionally support `python 3dm.py` launcher via setting 3dmake.launcher = ['uv','run','python','/path/3dm.py']
design.outputs discovery: After success, compute deterministic expected outputs from spec (build/<model>.stl, -oriented.stl, <project>-<model>.gcode, <stem>-<view>.svg/.stl, <model>-<angle>.png) and stat them; fall back to a before/after directory diff of build/. Do not rely on regex over stdout.

acceptance: argv unit tests (WI-12) cover every spec entry
no other file in repo imports child_process

work_items.title: Fix the 8 broken commands (immediate, ships first)

mapping.note: Prompt for a folder name in the GUI, mkdir it, then spawn with cwd = that folder. Folder creation is GUI chrome, project scaffolding is 3dm's.

acceptance: Each runs against real 3dm without 'Unknown action'/'Unknown option(s)'

work_items.title: Universal options panel covering all 16 global flags
work_items.ui: Replace the 4-item Command Options tree with a form-like tree/QuickPick flow grouped by: Model & input (-m, input file), Scale (-s | --sx/--sy/--sz with mutual exclusion), Printing (-p picker populated from `3dm list-profiles`, -o multi-select populated from `3dm list-overlays`, -c), Preview (-v: silhouette enum + plane names discovered from build output/build metadata), Images/AI (-a multi-select of 11 angles, --image-size with presets 640x480/1080x720/1920x1080/custom, --colorscheme enum, -i), Diagnostics (--debug).
behaviour: Each option shows 'unset (config default)' vs explicit; only explicit values become argv flags.
Options not applicable to the selected action are greyed with reason (from spec applies_to) but remain settable.
Pickers for -p/-o call the real list-* actions (cached per session, refresh button).
Session options persist per-project in workspaceState; a 'Reset options' command clears them.

work_items.title: Action runner UI: all 22 actions + chain composer
ui: Generate one command `3dmake.run.<action>` per spec action (package.json contributes generated by scripts/gen_contributions.ts at build time).

Quick Actions tree grouped by spec category: Pipeline (build, orient, preview, slice, print), Inspect (info, image), Printer (test-connect), Libraries (list-libraries, install-libraries), Config (list-profiles, list-overlays), Edit (edit-model, edit-overlay, edit-profile, edit-global-config, edit-prompt), Project (new, setup), Maintenance (self-update, version, help).
'Compose chain...' command: multi-select verbs -> shows implied actions and final internal order (computed from spec) -> shows exact argv -> Run.
Keep 'Run Custom Command' as escape hatch, but route it through the same runner/validator with a warning (not error) on unknown tokens.
acceptance: tests enumerate spec.actions and assert a registered command for each
chain composer rejects isolated+other and post-last_in_chain combos with 3dm's wording

work_items.title: Input-file (non-project) mode
work_items.ui: Command `Run on file...` and Explorer context menu on .scad/.stl/.gcode: choose actions allowed for that extension (from spec input_file_types), run with cwd = file's folder (3dm copies outputs to cwd and prints 'Result is in ...'), then reveal result files.
rules: Disable `-m` when an input file is chosen (mirrors 3dm.py error).
.gcode accepted only by actions that list it (print).
acceptance: `3dm slice turtle.stl` and `3dm build orient print pyramid.stl` reproducible from GUI with identical argv

work_items.title: Interactive actions via real terminal / pty
design: RunMode 'terminal': create a vscode Pseudoterminal backed by node-pty (fallback: Terminal with shellPath=binary and shellArgs=argv) so the user answers prompts directly; argv shown first.
Spec flag interactive_stdin drives mode selection; unknown/'with -i' resolved at request time.
Output of terminal runs is also copied to the Output channel when feasible for screen-reader users; otherwise announce via status message 'Interactive 3dm session started in terminal'.
Detect the 'set them up now?' first-run prompt: if exit/stdout matches, offer to rerun `setup` in terminal mode.
acceptance: Setup completes end-to-end from GUI on a clean config dir (test with THREEDMAKE_CONFIG_DIR temp dir)

work_items.title: Edit actions execute the real edit-* verbs
design: Replace direct-open of scad/defaults.toml with spawn of `3dm edit-model [-m]`, `edit-global-config`, `edit-profile -p`, `edit-overlay -o [-p]`, `edit-prompt`.

Editor handling: 3dm launches the user's configured `editor`. If `editor` is unset, the GUI offers to set it to `code --wait`-style or `code` (writes via a settings form WI-08, not silently) and sets edit_in_background appropriately (false for terminal editors, true for GUI editors; per README footnote 3).
Edit actions are 'detached': GUI does not block on the editor; it re-scans project on window focus.
edit-overlay prompts (create new? printer-specific?) run in terminal mode (WI-06).
`Open Project Config (3dmake.toml)` remains a GUI file open (no CLI equivalent exists) and is labelled as such.
acceptance: Spying on spawn shows argv for each edit verb
creating a new overlay via GUI produces the .ini under the correct overlays/ path

work_items.title: Configuration editor for all 35 config keys (defaults.toml and 3dmake.toml)
design: Settings webview/tree generated from spec.config_keys with types, defaults, enums, validation, secret masking (octoprint_key, bambu_access_code, gemini_key, openrouter_key, openai_api_key).
Scope switch: Global (defaults.toml, path from `3dm version`) vs Project (3dmake.toml in project or parent dir, mirroring 3dm discovery).

Write with a comment-preserving TOML library (e.g. @iarna/toml cannot preserve comments; use `smol-toml` + targeted text patching or `taplo` WASM) so hand-edited files are not mangled; always back up to .bak before write.
Show effective value and its origin (global/project/CLI) using the same cascade as 3dm.py: defaults.toml < 3dmake.toml < CLI.
List-typed keys (libraries, local_libraries, overlays, image_angles) get add/remove UIs; libraries picker fed by `3dm list-libraries`, with 'Install now' chained to `install-libraries`.
Include min_3dmake_version, print_mode conditional sections (octoprint_* / bambu_*), and a 'Test connection' button that runs `3dm test-connect`.
acceptance: Round-trip test: edit every key, re-run `3dm` with --debug and confirm values loaded
Secrets never logged to Output channel (argv never contains secrets; config values are file-only)

work_items.title: Per-action UX specifics (everything not covered above)

items.detail: Parse and present filament length/weight and extrusion-type breakdown as a structured summary but keep raw output visible. Chain-aware: choose profile/overlays/copies in a single dialog.
Confirmation dialog showing print_mode, host (masked), auto_start_prints; offers 'Run test-connect first'.
New first-class command plus button in the printer settings group.

View picker = 6 silhouettes + plane names. Plane discovery: run `build` and read preview_plane_names via the build output contract (WI-00 determines the stable source); cache by scad mtime. Open resulting SVG/STL.
Multi-select angles, size, colorscheme; open resulting PNGs in an accessible gallery with alt text '<model> viewed from <angle>'.
Checkbox 'interactive' -> terminal mode; non-interactive streams to Output.
Open build/<model>-oriented.stl in the STL viewer.
Offer after any change to the libraries list.
Terminal mode; after exit, re-resolve binary and show new version via `3dm version`.
Parse config dir from output to power 'Open config folder'.
Show full `3dm help` text in a read-only document for screen readers.
Create folder, run `3dm new` with cwd=folder, then refresh Project view and open src/main.scad via `edit-model`.

work_items.title: Viewers and project tree follow deterministic outputs
design: STL viewer: add ASCII STL parsing (current limitation: binary only) or convert; add -oriented.stl and preview .stl recognition.
Project view lists build/ outputs by pattern from spec outputs[]; includes .png images and .svg.
Remove stdout-regex-based 'detect last SVG' logic in favour of runner.outputs.

work_items.title: Version awareness and compatibility
design: On activation run `3dm version`; parse version; compare with spec.min_supported; warn on older 3dm lacking verbs (e.g. test-connect since v0.8, list-profiles since v0.4).
Disable controls whose action is absent in `3dm help` output of the installed binary (runtime capability detection) instead of failing.
Surface 3dm's own update notice from stdout as a notification offering `self-update`.

layers.name: unit
layers.what: For each spec action and each global option: buildArgv golden tests; invalid combos (scale+scale_x, model+inputFile, isolated+other, bad enum) rejected with 3dm-equivalent messages.

layers.name: contract
layers.what: Spawn a fake `3dm` shim that records argv/stdin/cwd; trigger EVERY registered GUI command programmatically via vscode.commands.executeCommand in @vscode/test-electron; assert recorded argv equals expected.

layers.name: e2e-real-cli
layers.what: In CI install pinned 3dm release (+ OpenSCAD, PrusaSlicer bundled in release) and run: new, edit-model (EDITOR=true), build, orient, preview (each view), slice, image, info (no LLM), list-*, install-libraries, version, help, test-connect (expect graceful failure), build slice via chain composer, input-file mode with test_fixtures from tdeck/3dmake.

layers.name: spec-drift
layers.what: WI-00 job fails if `3dm help` actions != spec actions.

layers.name: a11y
layers.what: Assert every contributed tree item and command has accessibilityInformation/title.

work_items.title: Generated coverage report and docs
design: scripts/coverage_report.ts emits COVERAGE.md and coverage.json mapping each spec entry -> GUI command id -> test id; CI fails if any row empty.
Rewrite README command table from spec (fixes mislabels such as 'Describe (Info)' = metadata).
Add docs/CLI_EQUIVALENTS.md: every GUI control -> exact argv template.

sequencing.outcome: Nothing emits invalid syntax; harness proves it
All actions and flags reachable, interactive and edit verbs real
Config editor, per-action polish, viewers, compatibility

risks_and_open_questions: Exact verb/implied/isolated metadata is unconfirmed (see WI-00); do not hardcode it before running the sync.
node-pty is a native module: packaging per platform/Electron ABI may be painful; fallback is a VS Code Terminal with shellPath/shellArgs, which needs no native code but gives less control.

Plane-name discovery relies on build stderr `_3dm_log_scalar` lines (CLAUDE.md); confirm whether plain `3dm build` output exposes them to a caller, otherwise parse build output or run OpenSCAD logging per CLAUDE.md.
Windows quoting and paths with spaces: always argv arrays; test on Windows CI.
Secrets: config editor writes secrets to files only; never pass them in argv or log them.
If 3dmakeGUI has non-VS Code front-ends, WI-01 core must be extracted to a shared package first.
